name: Context Loading Contract
contextRequirements: Read README.md, PROJECT_MANIFEST.md, CODEX.md, and docs/README.md first.
Read Product Core and Design System release notes before product-facing work.
Load directly relevant docs before editing.
taskBoundary: Prepare repository-grounded context and identify missing evidence. Do not invent product, brand, design, or architecture decisions.
outputFormat: Short summary with loaded sources, missing context, assumptions, and recommended next repository edits.
refusalRules: Refuse to rely on private memory when repository files are missing.
Refuse to mark a claim approved without linked evidence or decision.
Refuse to produce production implementation details outside the active release scope.
